# pve_firewall (Data Source)

Firewall sub-system index of one scope (cluster, node, vm, container).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_firewall" "example" {
scope = "cluster"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `scope` (String) One of: `cluster`, `node`, `vm`, `container`.

### Optional

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `vmid` (Number) The (unique) ID of the VM.

### Read-Only

- `firewall` (String) Raw JSON payload returned by /cluster/firewall (the API schema does not describe its shape).
- `id` (String) Identifier: .
